simple.meaning: שָׁקַע (shâqaʻ) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to subside ; by implication, to be overflowed , cease ; causatively, to abate , subdue.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across Numbers, Job, Jeremiah, Ezekiel, Amos, beginning at Numbers 11:2. Its contexts include land, Egypt.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁקַע (H8257).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: שָׁקַע (shâqaʻ) / H8257 is traced through Numbers 11:2, Job 40:25, Jeremiah 51:64, Ezekiel 32:14 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.usage: make deep, let down, drown, quench, sink.
definitions.full: H8257. shaqa [ שָׁקַע ] verb sink, sink down (so Late Hebrew שָׁקַע , Aramaic שְׁקַע ; Arabic has be smitten, prostrated, collapse ); — Qal Perfect 3feminine singular consecutive וְשָֽׁקְעָה ; Amos 9:5 it shall sink like the Nile (of land; opposed to עָלַה ); 3 feminine singular וַתִּשְׁקַע Num 11:2 (JE), of fire, it sunk down , died out; תִּשְׁקַע Jer 51:64 , of Babylon (like stone in water; opposed to קוּם ). Niph`al 3feminine singular נִשְׁקְעָה Amos 8:8 Qr, of land, sink (opposed to עָלָה ; = Qal Amos 9:5 ; Kt erroneous נשקה , compare W SG287 ). Hiph`il Imperfect 1singular מֵימֵיהֶם אַשְׁקִיעַ Ezek 32:14 I will make their waters sink , (settle, grow clear); 2 masculine singular לְשׁוֺנוֺ תַּשְׁקִיעַ וּחְֶבֶל Job 40:25 with a cord wilt thou make his tongue sink (? pull or press it down; of crocodile; Mich Suppl,2349 cited Thes 1477, compare Samaritan = חבשׁ bind ).
